offerAdmin.editHint: Saving replaces the items and targets. Drafts that used the old version must be saved again; submitted orders keep their prices.

offerAdmin.packagePriceHint: For one package. Spread over the paid items by list value; never above their list value.
offerAdmin.perLineHint: Give each paid item its net unit price (before VAT).

offerAdmin.vatIntro: VAT per product (pending the accountant; 14% by default). Only the owner changes it, and every change is audited. Drafts take the new rate when saved; submitted orders and issued invoices keep theirs.
